meta.reference: https://eiger-extreme.mammut.com/en (structure and rhythm only; nothing copied)
meta.method: 16 headless captures at 1440x900 across the full page, computed styles for type, pixel-bucket palette measurement (the skill's measure-colors script is not installed, an equivalent was run on the same captures)
meta.note: Reference DNA is used for layout, hierarchy, scale and rhythm. Palette, type and effects come from the Night Archive brief.

color.principle: Large solid color blocks alternate with full-bleed photography; one accent at roughly 1.5 percent coverage.

typography.principle: Two extremes and almost nothing in between. Huge words and tiny annotations create depth; long statements are set as large paragraphs, not as body copy.

spacing.rhythm: each chapter is roughly one to two viewports, generous empty space around small annotations

layout.grid: wide 12 column feel, frequent full-bleed breaks
compositions_observed: white field with inset photo at about 80 percent width and a tiny caption
dark stage with an isolated object and hairline annotations
solid accent block with a triptych of photos
centered statement over a darkened photo
scattered asymmetric collage with a thin route line
layout.principle: No composition repeats back to back.

motion.character: calm, large-scale, scroll-led; images scale and clip rather than fade

design_style.composition: cinematic cuts between photography and flat color fields
design_style.imagery: documentary photography at very large scale

accent.source: measured from specimen eyes and mouths (#B58E50 average), lifted for contrast

color.principle: Specimen photography already sits beside #122624, so solid abyss, moss and white blocks read as native to the images.

typography.display: Bebas Neue, tracking -0.02em, used only at large sizes
typography.annotation: IBM Plex Mono 11px for catalogue lines
typography.principle: Borrow the reference's extremes: huge display against tiny annotation, large paragraphs as statements.

motion.easing: expo.out for reveals, power2.inOut for clips, none for scrubs
motion.rule: each image owns a different reveal

hero_depth.tech: separated dinosaur layer over a synthesised clean sky plate

per_section_reveals: type mask zoom and scan line

intro.tech: DOM + SVG pixel sprites, GSAP timeline
